content: For patients who are unable to tolerate statins or who do not achieve their target LDL cholesterol levels despite statin therapy, alternative lipid-lowering agents may be considered. These alternatives include bempedoic acid, which works by inhibiting ATP citrate lyase, an enzyme involved in cholesterol synthesis, and inclisiran, a small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapy that targets PCSK9 to enhance LDL receptor recycling and reduce LDL cholesterol levels.
